**PotentialBreaks 1.1.1**, the first public release.

Dig, chop, play: a random drum break from your own library on 16 pads, chopped and matched to your tempo. See the [PotentialBreaks page](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/potential-plugins/blob/main/plugins/potentialbreaks/README.md) for everything it does and its limitations.

**Download** `PotentialBreaks-1.1.1-mpc-armv7.zip` below. It's for Gen1 (32-bit) MPCs on MPC OS 3.x and has been tested on an MPC One. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.

Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome. [Open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/potential-plugins/issues/new/choose).
